constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require the function's entry point and packaging for the OS-only runtime; confirm the handler runs on the replacement before deploying.
This runtime is still supported today; the rule is a warning ahead of the announced date, so plan the move before it.

steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from provided.al2023 to a supported AWS Lambda OS-only runtime identifier (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime

steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins provided.al2023.
steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

rules.summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists provided.al2023 as supported with a projected deprecation date of 2029-06-30. After that date AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.
rules.title: AWS Lambda OS-only runtime provided.al2023 runtime reaches end of life on 2029-06-30
